data.name: StarStruck
data.detailed_description:
The Universe Has Gone Mad. It’s Time to Claw it Back.

The galaxy is in shambles. A mysterious, cursed villain has brainwashed the cosmos, turning the Food World, Creature World, and Alien World against one another in a never-ending cycle of violence.

The only hope? Tigo. A blind tiger with a sharp instinct and an even sharper aim. Alongside a crew of loyal comrades, you must survive the "StarStruck" gauntlet, defeat the unnamed evil, and break the curse that has turned the stars into a battlefield.

Survive the Gauntlet

It’s a race against time and tide. Fight through 5 escalating rounds of bullet-hell intensity. Each stage is more brutal than the last, culminating in a final, screen-shaking boss fight that will test every buff and weapon in your inventory.

Total Tactical Freedom

There is no "right" way to win. Explore sprawling levels filled with hidden weapons and secret paths.

  • Side Missions: Complete objectives to earn game-changing buffs.

  • Loot & Scavenge: Crack open chests to find rare gear.

  • Play Your Way: Use stealth, speed, or overwhelming firepower to accomplish your goals.

Visceral, "Bloody Good" Combat

In StarStruck, enemies don't just disappear—they fall apart.

  • Mutilation System: Target limbs to slow down threats.

  • Elemental Chaos: Freeze them solid, set them ablaze, or use high-grade explosives to blow them to smithereens.

  • Arsenal Variety: Earn new guns at the end of every round and find hidden experimental weapons tucked away in the shadows.

Meta-Progression: Build the Ultimate Hunter

Collect Gems from fallen foes and completed missions to fuel your revenge.

  • Upgrade Everything: Enhance gun stats and ability cooldowns.

  • Expand Your Roster: Unlock new playable characters with unique playstyles.

  • New Frontiers: Use your riches to unlock increasingly difficult levels across the warring worlds.

data.short_description: Check this High-Octane Roguelite-Survivor TPS! Blast, burn, and mutilate your way through five rounds of escalating carnage. Hunt secrets, upgrade your arsenal, and break the curse of a mad villain to save a universe at war as Tigo, the galaxy’s last un-cursed tiger and his gang of unlikely friends.
